ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity contiguous region extending from the peduncle towards the trailing edge. High-intensity lobes are heavily patterned with low-intensity linear streaks and mottling, with solid low-intensity banding concentrated along the trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated acute angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant high-amplitude indentations (notches) are present on the inner trailing edges of both lobes near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite curve characterized by convexity along the distal outer edges transitioning to concavity as the contour approaches the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes. Scattered high-intensity punctate spots are visible within the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense clusters of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) radiating across the high-intensity white areas of both lobes. One prominent high-intensity linear mark is visible within the dark central pigmentation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes; barnacle clusters on distal tips; significant irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, circular high-intensity focal spot located within the dark pigmentation zone to the immediate right of the median notch.
